memorize_seed_page_description: Indlela yokugcina umushwana wakho wokubuyisa we-Bitcoin enkumbulweni ngokuphepha njengesipele esingabonakali. Amasu asebenzayo, imithetho yokuphepha, nokuthi kungani ukubamba ngenhloko kungafanele kube isipele sakho kuphela.
memorize_seed_h1_title: Indlela yokugcina i-Bitcoin ebuchosheni bakho: isipele esingabonakali esihamba nawe noma ngabe uya kuphi
memorize_seed_intro_p1: Umushwana wakho wokubuyisa uwukhiye omkhulu we-Bitcoin yakho. Abantu abaningi bawugcina ephepheni noma ensimbini. Ukubamba ngenhloko kungesinye isipele ongasifaka phezu kwalokho.
memorize_seed_intro_p2: Akubonakali. Akunasisindo. Kwaziwa nguwe wedwa. Akukho mlilo, akukho ukuphangwa, akukho ukuhlolwa emngceleni okungakuthatha kuwe.
memorize_seed_intro_p3: Cishe kubo bonke abantu, ukubamba ngenhloko kufanele kube phezu kwesipele esiphathekayo, hhayi esikhundleni saso. Lokho sizokuxoxa kabanzi ngakho ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
memorize_seed_callout_good_desc: Amagama akhiqizwe yisikhwama sehadiwe. I-entropy ephezulu. Kuphephile ukugcina ikhophi ekhanda lakho.
memorize_seed_callout_bad_desc: Ukhiye othathwe kumushwana ophasiwedi owuqambe wena. Wonakele. Uphucwa imali ngemizuzwana.
memorize_seed_not_brain_wallet_p1_a: Ezinsukwini zokuqala ze-Bitcoin, abantu bazama ukukhiqiza okhiye abayimfihlo besebenzisa imishwana yamaphasiwedi abayiqamba ngokwabo. Le ndlela yayibizwa ngokuthi
memorize_seed_not_brain_wallet_p1_c: futhi yayiyinhlekelele. Ama-hacker abhala izikripthi ukuze aqagele imishwana yamaphasiwedi evamile futhi aphuca izikhwama imali ngemizuzwana.
memorize_seed_not_brain_wallet_p2: Lokhu okubamba ngenhloko lapha kuhlukile. Amagama avela emthonjeni wesikhwama sehadiwe wokungaqondakali, hhayi emcabangweni wakho. Akusiyo into iskripthi esingayiqagela.
memorize_seed_not_brain_wallet_p3: Umushwana wakho wokubuyisa une-entropy ephezulu. Ukugcina ikhophi yawo ekhanda lakho akuwenzi ube buthakathaka. Kumane kuwugcine kwenye indawo.
memorize_seed_when_helpful_p1: Ukubamba ngenhloko kuyaqhakaza lapho izipele eziphathekayo zihluleka. Inhlekelele yemvelo ihlasela ikhaya lakho nepulethi yensimbi engaphakathi. Isikhukhula. Umlilo. Ukuphuma. Ubusela. Ukuwela umngcele lapho ungenakukwazi ukuphatha noma yini ebonakala njengengcebo.
memorize_seed_when_helpful_p2: Kuyasiza futhi esikhathini esifushane. Ukuhamba ngaphandle kwesipele kungcono kakhulu uma ungakwazi ukubuyisa isikhwama sakho noma kuphi emhlabeni.
memorize_seed_when_helpful_p3: Futhi kungesinye isigaba sokuvikeleka okwengeziwe. Uma isikhukhula, umlilo, nesela kuhlasela ngeviki elilodwa, inguqulo oyibambe ngenhloko yiyo ekubuyisela ekhaya.
memorize_seed_rules_p1: Ngaphambi kokuthi ubambe noma yini ngenhloko, qinisa izisekelo. Umushwana wakho wokubuyisa uyiphasiwedi ephakeme — uvikele nganoma yiziphi izindleko.
memorize_seed_rules_p2: Wukhiqize esikhwameni se-Bitcoin sangempela, hhayi kuwebhusayithi noma ku-app yefoni ongayethembi. Wonke umsebenzi uncike emagameni avela emthonjeni wangempela wokungaqondakali.
memorize_seed_rules_p3: Gcina okungenani isipele esisodwa esiphathekayo. Iphepha noma insimbi, ezindaweni eziphephile ezingaphezu kweyodwa. Ukubamba ngenhloko kuphezu kwalokho — akusona isikhundla saso.
memorize_seed_rules_p4: Ungakhulumi amagama ngezwi. Ngisho nakuwe ngokwakho, ngisho ngomoya. Amafoni nabasizi bezwi bezwa okungaphezu kwalokho ocabangayo.
memorize_seed_rules_p5: Ungawathayipheli kunoma yini. Akukho i-app yamanothi, akukho i-spreadsheet, akukho inothi elibhalwe ngokufihlakele, akukho "ukuhlola nje." Phatha noma yiyiphi ikhibhodi noma isikrini njengomsakazo wasemphakathini.
memorize_seed_rules_p6: Sebenza ngasese lapho uhlola. Vala umnyango. Mboza noma yiziphi amakhamera akhomba kuwe — kuhlanganise nekhamera yelephothophu lakho. Donsa amakhethini. Buyisela amagama ekugcineni ngomzuzu nje uma uyeka ukuhlola.
memorize_seed_technique_heading: Indlela yokubamba ngenhloko umushwana wakho wokubuyisa
memorize_seed_technique_p1: Amagama angahlelekile kunzima ukuwakhumbula kunomusho, kodwa kulula kunalokho okubukekayo. Imishwana yokubuyisa ngokuvamile inamagama ayishumi nambili noma angamashumi amabili nane kuye ngesikhwama sakho nezilungiselelo zaso. Noma yikuphi ukubala kulandela isigqi uma usinika sona.
memorize_seed_technique_p2: Hlukanisa umushwana ngezigaba. Amagama ayishumi nambili ehlukana kahle abe amaqembu amathathu amane, noma amaqembu amane amathathu. Amagama angamashumi amabili nane abe amaqembu amane ayisithupha noma amaqembu ayisithupha amane. Amaqembu amancane akulula ukuwagcina.
memorize_seed_technique_p3: Yakha indaba. Isigaba ngasinye sibe yindawo encane ecacile. Yenza zibe zingajwayelekile futhi zithile — ubuchopho bukhumbula okungajwayelekile. "Indlovu eluhlaza ipakishi ama-cactus phezu kwepiyano" iyahlala. "Amanye amagama mayelana nezilwane nomculo" akahlali.
memorize_seed_technique_p4: Sebenzisa indawo yenkumbulo. Cabanga indawo oyaziyo kahle — ikhishi lakho, indlela eya emsebenzini, ikamelo lakho lobuntwana. Beka igama ngalinye endaweni ethile. Hamba indlela ngengqondo ukuze ukhumbule ukulandelana.
memorize_seed_technique_p5: Yenze irayima noma uyihlabelele. Khetha umculo osuwaziyo bese ufaka amagama esigqini. Izingoma ziyanamathela.
memorize_seed_technique_p6: Khetha noma yiyiphi indlela ozwa iyimvelo. Abantu abaningi bagcina behlanganisa ezimbili — izigaba kanye nendaba, noma indawo yenkumbulo ehlanganiswe nomculo. Khetha noma yini esebenza kahle kuwe.
memorize_seed_repetition_heading: Yenza ukuphindaphinda kube yingxenye yosuku lwakho
memorize_seed_repetition_p1: Iqhinga liyivolomu, hhayi umzamo. Hlanganisa ukuhlola kwakho nento osuyenza nsuku zonke, futhi ukuphindaphinda kuyaqongelelana ngaphandle kokucabanga ngakho.
memorize_seed_repetition_p2: Ukuxubha amazinyo akho kabili ngosuku kungukuhlola okuyishumi nane ngeviki. Ukupheka isidlo sakusihlwa. Ukuhamba nenja. Ukushayela uye emsebenzini. Ukulala. Ukugeza. Khetha umkhuba owodwa noma emibili bese uvumela amagama ahambisane nawo.
memorize_seed_repetition_p3: Wagijime emqondweni wakho — ngokuthula, izindebe zivaliwe. Ungahlebi. Ungayinyakazisi umlomo wakho. Inhloso enkulu ukuthi akekho ongatshela ukuthi ukwenza lokhu.
memorize_seed_repetition_p4: Emva kwamasonto ambalwa, amagama ayayeka ukuba yinto okudingeka uyikhumbule futhi aqala ukuba yinto omane uyazi. Qhubeka nomkhuba inyanga noma ezimbili ukuze unamathele ngempela. Ungene kanye ngeviki ngemva kwalokho ukuze uwugcine umusha.
memorize_seed_test_p1: Kanye ngeviki, zifakazele ukuthi uyawazi ngempela umushwana. Inkumbulo iyathambeka — ingazwakala ijwayelekile ngaphandle kokuba inembe.
memorize_seed_test_p2: Thola indawo eyimfihlo engenamakhamera akhomba kuwe, kuhlanganise nekhamera yelephothophu lakho. Vala umnyango. Donsa amakhethini.
memorize_seed_test_p3: Bhala amagama ephepheni, ngokulandelana. Wahambise nesipele sakho esiphathekayo, hhayi nenkumbulo yakho. Inhloso enkulu ukubamba iphutha inkumbulo yakho engalibonayo.
memorize_seed_test_p4: Bhubhisa iphepha ngokuphelele. Lihlephule. Lishise. Ungaliphonsi lonke ekamelweni eliphukile lwemfucumfucu. Uma ushiye amagama athile, yenza imizuzu eyengeziwe yokuhlola okujwayelekile bese uyazama futhi ngeviki elilandelayo.
memorize_seed_dont_rely_p1: Inkumbulo ithembekile kuze kufike lapho ingathembekile khona. Ingcindezi, ubudala, ukugula, ukulimala kwekhanda, noma isikhala eside esanele phakathi kokuhlola kungasula umushwana. Akukho ihluku elithi "ukhohlwe iphasiwedi" kwi-Bitcoin.
memorize_seed_dont_rely_p2: Phatha ukubamba ngenhloko njengesipele esihambisanayo. Isipele sakho esiphathekayo siyisisekelo. Inguqulo esekhanda lakho ingumvikeli. Uma inhlekelele ihlasela isisekelo, umvikeli ukubuyisela ekhaya.
memorize_seed_dont_rely_p3: Izimo ezizodwa ezenza ukugcina enkumbulweni kuphela kufaneleke ezimbi kakhulu: ukubaleka endaweni yempi, ukubalekela ukushushiswa kombuso onobushiqela, ukuwela umngcele unempahla ezothathwa. Yize kunjalo, kuwumqondo omuhle ukwakha isipele esisha esiphathekayo lapho usufike endaweni ephephile.
